sanskrit_verse:
गृहीत्वापह्नुते यश् च साक्षिभिः शपथेन वा ।
विभाव्य दापयेन् न्यासं तत् समं विनयं तथा ॥
transliteration: gṛhītvāpahnute yaś ca sākṣibhiḥ śapathena vā | vibhāvya dāpayen nyāsaṃ tat samaṃ vinayaṃ tathā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who accepts possession of property through false witness or oath shall restore it fully, along with due compensation, in accordance with Nyāsa and Vinaya.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from truthful acknowledgment of possession
Causation arises through conscious distortion of testimony
Restoration logic aligns ownership with ontological truth
Consciousness alignment demands integrity in transactional acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claimant accepts property via false witness THEN the property AND equivalent value MUST BE returned to rightful source
IF an oath distorts factual possession THEN declarer's capacity to hold is null UNTIL restitution completes
ALL transactions under false declaration SHALL trigger automatic restoration protocol without punitive action
NYAYA requires verification of witness integrity BEFORE validation of transfer
VINAYA mandates completion process until original ontological state is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any case involving disputed property acquired through perjury or false oaths must invoke immediate restoration orders. The threshold for responsibility lies in the conscious act of misrepresentation before witnesses or deities. Authority to decide remains with those whose consciousness aligns with ontological facts, not procedural form.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that false witnessing disrupts causal flow of legitimate possession. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces back the distortion to its origin — thus requiring full reversal. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of falseness. Non-punitive reality rule ensures correction without infliction, preserving Dharma’s integrity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Identify original possessor and execute return of item plus compensatory value
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require declarer to acknowledge distortion publicly and commit to restoration
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign individual's transactional capacity through supervised restitution cycles
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Conduct ritual affirmation of truth-telling before competent authority until trust is re-established
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored where possession was falsely claimed. Reality remains non-punitive, governed by consciousness alone. All distortions revert by Nyāya; all beings realign by Vinaya.
